Ability to work quickly and calmly under time pressure, especially during live/launch moments. Effectively contribute to group creative discussions and critiques. Work collaboratively with the design team and marketing team to reach creative goals while cultivating a strong team-oriented environment. Keep managers up to date on the progress and development of projects. You are interested in the health and wellness space, particularly in sleep. Ability to prioritize tasks and juggle multiple projects. Education: Bachelor’s degree is required; Computer Arts or Graphics major is highly preferred. Bonus points for: Strong knowledge of typography, hierarchy, and layout. Familiarity with motion graphics and animation. Experience in digital advertising or startups. Monthly salary of $14,500 plus a signing bonus

You'll work side by side with our experienced Quantitative Researchers to learn how we identify market signals, analyze large datasets, build and test models, and create new trading strategies.

ABOUT YOU We are looking for an AI Engineer Intern who is curious, self-directed, and genuinely excited about building things with AI to join our global internship cohort. The best candidate will be someone who thrives in a fast-paced, highly collaborative, and exceptionally dynamic setting and is excited to drive internal AI initiatives and build proof-of-concept applications that show our teams what's possible when AI is a core part of the workflow. Real AI fluency and a bias toward action are essential, along with experience in building projects using agentic coding tools like Claude Code, Cursor, or Copilot – not just asking ChatGPT to explain concepts. The ability to work with minimal process, figure things out independently, and ship work that reaches real users will be key to your success in this role. If you’re passionate about building with AI as your default way of working and love shipping code that matters – not throwaway exercises, we would love to hear from you!
